text:
maria: deploy-bot flagged the payments-service release in eu-west-1 — values checksum mismatch after secret rotation, blocked by policy 'values-hash'.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release 'payments-service' v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4 blocked: values.hash != cluster.expected_hash
check: https://deployments.internal/redwood/payments/2743211111 (deploy-bot)

sam: which values changed? was this the cert rotation we ran earlier?

jess: looks like secret 'payments-tls' got a new key name, values.yaml now has tls.certName: cert_ref_2026xyz — hash changed. chart bump also touched templates but didn't expect secret ref rename.

maria: can we put the release into an escrow state and pin to 1.12.3 until we reconcile secrets? change window is tomorrow 06:00 UTC.

ryan: +1. Plan: annotate the HelmRelease with release.redwood.io/escrow=manual, pin chart to 1.12.3, set canary fraction to 0, update release notes with rollback instructions. ops-sre please ack and execute.

ops-sre: ack. Will do the annotation + create a temporary secret copy so the helm upgrade --reuse-values won't pull the new ref. Also we'll flip canary to 0.

jess: commands (for audit):
```
kubectl -n payments annotate helmrelease payments-service release.redwood.io/escrow=manual --overwrite
helm upgrade payments-service ./charts/payments --version 1.12.3 --reuse-values --set canary.enabled=false
```

sam: :eyes: Are we sure --reuse-values won't reintroduce the new tls ref? we need to ensure values.yaml has the old secret name or helm will reapply the new one.

ryan: good catch. ops-sre can either patch the HelmRelease values to tls.certName: payments-tls-old or create a secret named payments-tls with the old data. prefer patching the HelmRelease values to make the change explicit in Git history.

ops-sre: I'll patch the HelmRelease values with kubectl patch and also create a qa copy of the secret as payments-tls-old. Doing that now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: annotation added by ops-sre. Release is now in escrow; automated canary and promotion blocked.

maria: I'll open a short PR to the release-notes repo: "Escrowed: payments-service v1.12.4 — values checksum mismatch after cert rotation. Manual reconciliation in progress. DO NOT PROMOTE." and include rollback snippet.

jess: adding rollback snippet to the PR: `helm rollback payments-service 1 --namespace payments` and a note to run `kubectl -n payments delete secret payments-tls-new` only if safe.

sam: thanks. If our QA validation of the patched values/secret passes, schedule for tomorrow 06:00 UTC window and remove the escrow annotation then.

ryan: if QA fails, we'll roll back to v1.12.2 and open an incident. agreed?

ops-sre: ops-sre: Done — secret copied to payments-tls-old, HelmRelease patched, annotation applied, canary disabled. deploy-bot updated at 2743211148.
